hostname.description: Default hostname for HELO/EHLO and server identification.

monitoring_address.description: Address for the monitoring HTTP server (localhost only).

mail_delivery_agent_bin.description: Path to mail delivery agent binary.

mail_delivery_agent_args.description: Command-line arguments for the mail delivery agent.

data_dir.description: Directory where persistent data is stored.

suffix_separators.description: Suffix separators to strip from local usernames (e.g., user+tag -> user).

drop_characters.description: Characters to drop from local usernames during normalization.

dovecot_auth.description: Enable Dovecot authentication for unknown users.

dovecot_userdb_path.description: Explicit path to Dovecot userdb socket (leave blank for auto-detect).

dovecot_client_path.description: Explicit path to Dovecot client socket (leave blank for auto-detect).

haproxy_incoming.description: Expect incoming SMTP connections to use the HAProxy protocol.
